title: LLM Capacity and Cost Estimator
hints: Chat resends the history. Turn k of a session sends the system prompt, all k-1 earlier exchanges, and the new user message. Sum that over k = 1..T.
Only the prefix (system prompt plus history) can be cached. The new user message is always uncached, and output tokens are never discounted.
Size GPUs for the peak, not the average: peak_qps = avg_qps * peak_to_avg, and each GPU only runs at target_utilization.
Round GPUs up with math.ceil(x - 1e-9), and never go below one GPU.
